subject: Employment vetting evidence and training completion — SOC 2 bundle
messages:
From: Will Jensen <will.jensen@sigma-audits.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request — employee vetting and training artifacts

Jordan,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. To close out the personnel controls portion of our SOC 2 work we need a consolidated set of artifacts for employees who onboarded between 2026-07-01 and 2028-05-31. Specifically:  

- A single CSV with onboarding completion dates and training completion timestamps (including which training module and score).
- Redacted copies of background checks (PDFs) demonstrating identity and verification steps — redactions should hide PII not required for audit (SSNs, passport numbers) but leave employer, dates, and verification disposition visible.
- A list of offboarding tickets or completed deprovisioning actions covering leavers during the same period, with ticket IDs and closure timestamps.
- Chain-of-custody or attestations for redactions (who performed redaction and when).

If possible please provide the artifacts as: zipped redacted PDFs (one per person), plus CSVs for the summaries. If you have any DocuSign attestations for redactions/attestations, include links. Our deadline for evidence ingest is Friday 2028-06-16 COB.

Let me know if you anticipate any gaps — we can accept partial deliveries plus a plan for the remaining items.

Thanks,
Will
Sigma Audits
will.jensen@sigma-audits.com
(415) 555-0194

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Will Jensen <will.jensen@sigma-audits.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — employee vetting and training artifacts

Will — thanks for the clear checklist. Plan below and action owners:  

- Onboarding/training CSV: we’ll produce a consolidated CSV (onboarding-completion-summary-2028-06.csv) with columns: employee_id, name, hire_date, role, manager, training_module, training_completion_timestamp, quiz_score, remediation_needed. (Owner: Mina Haddad)
- Background checks: redaction batch will be handled by HR ops — we’ll supply a zip of redacted PDFs (bg-checks-redacted-bundle-2028-06.zip). We will include a short redaction log (who redacted, method, timestamp). (Owner: Laura Bennett)
- Offboarding/deprovisioning: pulling closure tickets from our internal ITSM; we’ll include offboarding-ticket-log-2027-2028.csv with ticket ids and timestamps and a short summary of automated deprovisioning actions executed. (Owner: Mina Haddad)
- Attestation: I will sign a brief attestation confirming redactions and chain-of-custody; we can use DocuSign and I’ll circulate immediately.

We expect to deliver the first pass of CSVs and the redaction bundle by EOD Thursday (2028-06-14), and the DocuSign attestation the same day. If we hit any individual record-level issues (missing authorizations), we’ll flag them and include a remediation timeline.

Attachments included in this reply: 
- onboarding-completion-summary-draft-2028-06.csv (partial) [CSV stub]

Laura — please confirm you can complete the redactions by Thursday. Mina — can you confirm the ITSM export will include ticket closure timestamps and the primary deprovisioning event id?

— Jordan
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Will Jensen <will.jensen@sigma-audits.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-14T10:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — employee vetting and training artifacts

On Thu, Jun 13, 2028 at 11:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Laura — please confirm you can complete the redactions by Thursday. Mina — can you confirm the ITSM export will include ticket closure timestamps and the primary deprovisioning event id?

Jordan, Mina, Will — I’m on it. Quick status:  

- Redaction batch: HR ops has a queue of 1,082 background-check PDFs covering the requested window. We’ve started an automated redaction pass that removes SSNs and passport numbers and flags edge cases for manual review. Expect final zip with redaction log by 18:00 PT Thursday.
- Edge cases: roughly 12 records have attachments that include scanned pages with handwritten notes; those will need manual redaction and will be delivered as a separate mini-batch with an explanation of why manual redaction was required.
- Chain-of-custody: we’ll include a CSV redaction_log.csv with columns: file_name, redactor_name, redaction_method (automated/manual), redaction_timestamp, review_stamp. I’ll attach the log to the zip.

Also attaching the training-quiz-scores-2028.csv draft (partial) — quiz scores are correlated to module completion. We mask employee_id in the public audit bundle and provide a mapping in a secure Drive link per your request (Will).

Laura
Head of HR Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: training-quiz-scores-2028.csv [CSV stub]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Will Jensen <will.jensen@sigma-audits.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-14T17:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — employee vetting and training artifacts

Will — delivering the evidence bundle as promised. Summary of what's included in the attached zip: 

1) onboarding-completion-summary-2028-06.csv — finalized CSV with onboarding + training completion timestamps and quiz scores; column-level descriptions included in first row.
2) bg-checks-redacted-bundle-2028-06.zip — redacted background check PDFs (redaction_log.csv inside the zip). Manual-redaction-mini-batch-2028-06.pdf included for the 12 edge cases with redaction notes.
3) offboarding-ticket-log-2027-2028.csv — export from ITSM with ticket_id, employee_id (hashed), deprovision_event_id, timestamp, primary_deprovision_tool (SCIM/Okta API), and closure_note.
4) training-quiz-scores-2028.csv — quiz-level scores and remediation flags.
5) DocuSign attestation link: https://app.docusign.com/secure/verify/ABC12345-attestation — I completed the attestation confirming the redaction chain-of-custody and that the bundle includes all records available in the retention window.

Notes/limitations: 
- A small subset (12 records) required manual redaction due to handwritten scans; those are documented separately inside the zip. We are providing hashed IDs in CSVs; if you need cleartext mapping we will provide it under an encrypted transfer and with a Data Transfer Agreement in place.
- Retention: per our policy, originals are retained in HR's secure vault for 7 years; redacted copies are what we supply for audits.

If you need any further breakdowns (by region or manager), let me know — we can provide pivot-ready CSVs.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: onboarding-completion-summary-2028-06.csv, bg-checks-redacted-bundle-2028-06.zip, offboarding-ticket-log-2027-2028.csv, training-quiz-scores-2028.csv
